title: SharkventurousCraft
description: SharkventurousCraft is a Create-focused exploration modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge).
body:
# SharkventurousCraft

**SharkventurousCraft** is a Minecraft **1.21.1 NeoForge** modpack built around exploration, adventure, and improving the overall survival experience while keeping the game stable and smooth to play.

The pack brings together a large collection of mods that expand the world, add more places to explore, improve gameplay mechanics, and provide many quality-of-life improvements. The goal is to keep the core feeling of Minecraft while making the game feel bigger, more alive, and more fun to play over long survival worlds.

You will encounter larger and more varied terrain, many new structures to discover, new equipment and items to collect, and additional systems that make building, exploring, and progressing through the game more interesting. Alongside this, the pack includes many performance improvements so the game runs better even with a large number of mods installed.

SharkventurousCraft is designed to work well for **both singleplayer and multiplayer**, making it suitable for playing alone or with friends on a server.

## Features

* Expanded world generation and exploration
* More structures and places to discover
* Additional items, equipment, and mechanics
* Many quality-of-life improvements
* Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay
* Multiplayer friendly with built-in voice chat support

## Requirements

Minecraft Version: **1.21.1**
Loader: **NeoForge**
Recommended RAM: **6–8 GB**

## Multiplayer

The modpack supports multiplayer and can be used on servers. (that have the same mods as here
